findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in Jinja2 internals
 * @description Detect use of pickle, marshal, or json with object_hook that may deserialize untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/jinja2-unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe use of serialization APIs inside Jinja2 (verify that data is trusted)."
findings.hypothesis: Jinja2 may use unsafe deserialization primitives internally

message.text: Potentially unsafe use of serialization APIs inside Jinja2 (verify that data is trusted).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Jinja2 sandbox escape via getattr / attribute access
 * @description Find flows from template-controlled names into getattr, __import__, or attribute access that may allow sandbox escape.
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/jinja2-sandbox-escape
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-94
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module SandboxEscapeConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) { any() }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(API::CallNode call |
      call = API::builtin("getattr").getACall() and sink = call.getArg(1)
      or call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall() and sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module SandboxEscapeFlow = TaintTracking::Global<SandboxEscapeConfig>;
import SandboxEscapeFlow::PathGraph

from SandboxEscapeFlow::PathNode source, SandboxEscapeFlow::PathNode sink
where SandboxEscapeFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential sandbox escape: data flows into getattr / __import__.", source, "tainted value"
findings.hypothesis: Potential sandbox escape or gadget usage via getattr / __import__ in Jinja2 internals.
